Below the time, black text reads "拆禮物了" accompanied by a large red heart emoji. The cat is lying horizontally and is tightly wrapped in a red-and-white vertically striped bag that is tied with an oversized red ribbon bow, mimicking a gift box. A brown baguette with visible scores on its crust protrudes from behind the cat's head within the bag. (3) The entire composition is a 2D graphic with clean lines and flat, vibrant colors. No camera movement or cuts occur throughout the duration; the image remains perfectly static. At the extreme bottom edge, fine green text provides copyright notice for "MOCHI DAD/THAT FISH CORP."
